# Daily Agent Benchmarks

> Daily Agent Benchmarks: a daily, searchable index of new AI agent benchmark papers on arXiv: LLM agents, web and GUI agents, coding / SWE agents, tool use, computer use, multi-agent, embodied and safety evaluations. Titles, authors, abstracts, citations, and PDF links.

Papers are pulled from the arXiv API once a day, filtered to LLM / AI agent benchmarks, and grouped by arXiv announcement day. Each paper has a static page with title, authors, abstract, field, citation count, and links to the arXiv abstract, PDF, and HTML versions.

## Site

- [Home](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/): latest agent benchmarks with BM25 search
- [Archive](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/archive.html): every paper grouped by month and day
- [Atom feed](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/feed.xml): latest 50 papers
- [JSON index](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/data/index.json): full machine-readable data
- [Source code](https://github.com/XBsleepy/daily-agent-benchmarks)
